title: tui: cursor u16 overflow at 65535-byte input boundary
description:
In kith-tui/src/ui.rs draw_input: visible_cursor_col is cast to u16. Input is capped at 65536 bytes (enforced in event.rs). A maximally filled ASCII input has width 65536 which does not fit in u16 (max 65535), so the as u16 cast wraps to 0 in release builds. The cursor appears at column 0 instead of end of line. In debug builds the cast would panic if using checked arithmetic.

Fix: cap the computed cursor column at u16::MAX before casting, or use u16::try_from(...).unwrap_or(u16::MAX).
